title: Sales & Service Engineer
job_description:
Degree in Chemistry, Pulp & Paper, Science or technical equivalent Prefer candidate with at least 1-3 years working experience in the related field. Good in lab experiment skill Good communication skills, interpersonal skills and problem-solving skills, sensitive to customer needs and changing business environment, as well as seeking new business opportunities Proficient in written and spoken English, Bahasa Malaysia and Mandarin language for purpose of communication and reporting to customer which is to be serviced Good computer skills with capability in data analysis tools and presentation skills (word, excel, ppt) Self-motivated, independent, customer oriented Able to work flexible hours and occasional travel is required.

Work with senior sales personnel to obtain orders and establish new accounts. Call on existing and potential customers to analyze their needs, requirements, strategic plans, and then implement practical application of products, troubleshooting and recommending new applications, equipment and procedure for existing products. Report to management regarding account activities, customers' needs, prices, competitors' activities and product acceptability. Responsible for all aspects of safety on the job, including the operation and maintenance of equipment safety and complying with policy regarding the shipping of analytical samples. Support company ESG.

-Accommodation provided with Wi-Fi -Phone data package provided. Medical Insurance (also cover spouse and children) -Annual Health check-up -Wedding Award -Baby Shower Award Annual Leave EPF SOCSO EIS Performance Bonus Car Allowance

Laboratory Microsoft Office Applications Chemistry Communication skills Problem-solving skills Paper or Pulp
